name: 135 East Hyogo Dry Gin
base_ingredient: [cần kiểm tra] Distributor sheet: distilled junmai sake (Yamadanishiki rice) from Akashi Sake Brewery; Drinkhacker: 100% grain neutral spirit with a touch of sake
production: Botanicals distilled separately in batches, then blended
Master Distiller Kimio Yonezawa tested ~50 Japanese plants before choosing the final five Japanese botanicals
history: 1888 | Akashi chosen to set Japan Standard Time (135th meridian east)
2017 | 135° East launched for the family's 100th anniversary of distilling
serve_official: Neat, on ice, or G&T garnished with yuzu peel
notes: Named after the 135th meridian east that runs through Akashi; distillery sits in front of the Akashi-Kaikyo Bridge. Drinkhacker also lists lime among botanicals (not in brand sheet). Backlog year 2018 vs ~2017 per sources.
